learning_outcomes.text: Know the different Mechanical Manufacturing Systems and Processes
Designs manufacturing processes for given parts taking into account technological and economic criteria.
Is able to select machines, tooling, cutting tools and working parameters for different manufacturing processes.
Is able to work in a team, apply critical reasoning, make decisions, and communicate knowledge and conclusions in the field of industrial engineering.

syllabus_topics: Introduction to manufacturing processes. Classification. Materials. Metrology.
Manufacturing processes for metal parts (Machining. Casting. Deformation. Powder metallurgy)
assessment_rules: There is no minimum mark in the parts. No parts are validated for the extraordinary sitting. Students who do not pass the course in the ordinary sitting must take an exam covering the entire course in the extraordinary sitting, and the mark obtained in this exam will be 100% of the final course mark.
